scope: Original TransitionController Arena/Menu coroutine decisions and timing with explicit local runner/context owners
arena_coroutine: IsTransitioning=true, then synchronous OnSwitching; yield source WaitForSecondsRealtime coverDelay
If RunnerActive: yield TearDownRunnerCoroutine, then yield null twice; preserve InArena and do not invoke dcn/context events on this branch
If no active runner: dcn sets InArena=true, toggles source context objects unless batch mode, raises OnSwitchedToArena, then OnContextChanged(true)
Both paths yield WaitUntil(!hq.InterstitialPlaying); this is not a runner-ready predicate
Call SpawnRunner(requestedMode); that owner writes GameMode before new runner initialization and emits OnRunnerSpawned
While NetworkedGameController is absent and elapsed<15, add unscaledDeltaTime and yield null; elapsed does not advance from scaled Time.deltaTime
If still absent after timeout: yield source Menu transition with LocalGameState.MultiModePicker7, then end outer coroutine
On controller presence: yield null five times, invoke OnSwitched while IsTransitioning is still true, then clear IsTransitioning
menu_coroutine: Set transitioning, raise switching, wait coverDelay realtime, always yield teardown, dco sets InArena=false/context objects/menu event/context(false), RequestLocalState(requested), invoke switched, clear transitioning

runner_teardown_source.manual_stop: TearDownRunnerCoroutine/ei first marks stopRequested=true, then yields cyv/eg
runner_teardown_source.shutdown: If runner root exists and contains NetworkRunner: Shutdown(true, reason0, false), then WaitUntil shutdown predicate
runner_teardown_source.destroyed_event: Destroy root, clear stored root reference, synchronously invoke OnRunnerDestroyed, yield null one frame, then complete
runner_teardown_source.total_after_destroy_event: One frame inside teardown plus two null yields in the Arena outer coroutine before its interstitial wait

canvas_round_lifecycle.subscription: CanvasAndCamera.Start subscribes ccu VA0x3416da8 to RunnerSpawner.OnRunnerDestroyed
canvas_round_lifecycle.retry_gate: If RunnerSpawner.IsRetrying, ccu skips normal clearing
canvas_round_lifecycle.normal_clear: Clear winning-player reference, cache network state0, CancelInvoke winning-player focus, directly SetActive(false) on all non-null networkedPairs.uiScreens, then refresh topbar modules
canvas_round_lifecycle.reopen: When the new runner emits Round4, ccs/ccy activates Round and TopBar_InGame under allowed local state None0/Paused10. Tutorial receives real Unity OnDisable/OnEnable through the Round hierarchy.
canvas_round_lifecycle.minimal_host_interface: NotifyRunnerDestroyed(false) must synchronously clear all network screens and reset UIFlow/HUD cached network state to0 before new actors are spawned. No reflective lifecycle invocation and no artificial state enum are needed.
canvas_round_lifecycle.topbar: cdc only refreshes menu TopBarModule membership; ccr controls camera follow. TopBar_InGame visibility belongs to Round4.uiScreens and its original legacy Appear animation, whose pivotY runs -5 to1 over about0.6667 scaled seconds.

api.enumerators: CreateToArena(mode), CreateToMenu(localState); host owns StartCoroutine and repeated-request guard while IsTransitioning
api.required_context: RunnerActive, NetworkControllerExists, InterstitialPlaying, TearDownRunner IEnumerator, SpawnRunner(mode), RequestLocalState(state), SetContextObjects(arena)
api.source_game_mode: Set mode within SpawnRunner owner, not at the initial transition request

validation.scope: Actual et/eu MoveNext plus dcn/dco instructions, bounded engine/runner callbacks, iterator states, yielded object type/time, source flags, callback order and bool context argument; old/no-runner, ready/missing NGC, timeout bounds, batch-mode branches

limits: This helper is independent of Preview/HUD/Timing and does not implement Fusion shutdown/reconnect or native scene loading. The local owner must bridge actual actor teardown and emit the source runner/UI events.
Context callbacks must preserve actual source menu/arena objects where those objects exist. Batch-mode source suppresses object activation only; context flags and events still occur.
Cover rendering, camera/topbar module refresh, original local-menu navigation and ads/interstitial ownership remain external. Interstitial completion is not synthesized.
A combined live Practice Pause->Restart run is pending host integration. Coroutine/control-flow checks do not establish whole-game or cross-platform frame equivalence.
